name: Cavargna (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cavargna within branches and the inscription COMUNE DI CAVARGNA in black arched above.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 7 June 2024.

features.role: Cavargna arms — stars, a figure and a tower on blue and red, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CAVARGNA arched above the arms
